title: Just So You Know
text: did I want it to hurt? honestly yeah, kind of. some part of me wanted to wake up and feel it, wanted the morning to be off in some way that I couldn’t ignore, wanted something to just confirm that what we had actually had weight to it. but it didn’t. same time, same everything, same silence I always wake up to and that was almost stranger than if it had actually hurt loudly? idk how to explain that. quiet indifference is a weird thing to sit with when u were the one who actually felt something. I’m not complaining rn. I just… I wanted to be honest with u for once without making it sound nicer than it is.

title: This Is What Quiet Looks Like
text: five days and I genuinely didn’t fill it with anything. didn’t distract myself, didn’t spiral, just let the silence exist and worked through my days the way I always do. my phone was somewhere in the room and I just didn’t go looking for it. what surprised me though, and I wasn’t expecting this at all, was how fast the quiet stopped feeling like something was missing from it. like it started feeling like mine again? I don’t know if that makes sense. it probably doesn’t. but there was this specific moment around day three where I realised I’d been lending something out without even noticing and now I had it back and I didn’t know how to feel about that honestly.

title: I Actually Like Who I’m Becoming
text: looked in the mirror a couple days ago, not in a weird way just kind of checked in, and I actually liked what I saw. not just physically, although yeah that too, the body’s dialled in rn. more the expression on my face. something is settling in me that wasn’t there before and I can’t fully name it yet. quieter I guess. more certain about things. and then randomly I remembered that u and nuzu actually made something for me once and I don’t know why that came up in that moment but it did. I buy my own everything, always have, so I don’t usually have a category for that kind of thing. but that one got its own category. I don’t think I ever told u that.

title: What We Could Have Been
text: I sent u that text. u know the one. I was mostly talking about myself if I’m being real, classic, but somewhere in the middle of it u laughed at something I said and I heard it and I laughed too and for like two seconds the whole thing felt stupidly easy. like something that didn’t need to be built or maintained, it just… existed. I think about that sometimes. not all the time. just the way u think about a song u heard once in a specific place that u can’t go back to and u can’t even remember the name of the song but u remember exactly how it felt to hear it.

title: The Me You Actually Got
text: u didn’t get a rehearsed version of me. some people get the edited one, the one that shows up correctly and says the right things at the right volume and never makes it weird. u got the one that existed between the edits. and u used to send me voice notes. covering songs, my songs specifically, the ones I actually love, in ur own voice, completely unprompted. I never told u what that did to me. I should have honestly. there’s something about hearing someone u actually like wrap their voice around something u love… it quietly destroys the part of u that was trying to stay unbothered. I was doing so well at being unbothered before those.

title: I Told You Something
text: okay so technically I didn’t tell u anything, that’s the part that makes it sit so strange. u found it yourself, somewhere in going through my numbers, a fake account wearing my name that I had nothing to do with. and instead of just coming to me first, instead of asking me directly, u took it somewhere else. to someone else. that’s the part I keep returning to rn, not the finding, just the direction u walked in after. and when I found out there was this sharp thing in my stomach, like missing a step in the dark when u were completely sure of ur footing. I’ve been misread before. in rooms I still have to sit in. it’s one of the things I hate most and I don’t say that lightly.

title: The Moment I Knew
text: it was never about the cost, I need u to understand that clearly because if u think this is about money u’ve missed the entire thing. I’ve always taken care of myself, always. what I actually wanted, what I think I’ve always wanted, is to feel remembered through someone’s actions. not words. I don’t know when I realised that about myself but I know it’s true. the thing that gets me is being looked at constantly and still not being looked into? like being seen but not known? that’s a specific kind of feeling and I’m more familiar with it than I’d like to be and I was starting to think maybe that was changing. I was actually starting to think that.

title: You Talked
text: I don’t need to be loud about this. u talked and it got somewhere it had no business being. someone I actually respect heard something about me that wasn’t true, built on something I never agreed to share, and it was just… out there wearing my name. and even now, even knowing it’s been handled, there’s this quiet thing I can’t fully shake. it’s not paranoia I don’t think. it’s more like this honest awareness that some people will look at me slightly differently because of it, even if everyone moves on, even if the record gets corrected. rumours leave something behind. I haven’t fully made peace with that part yet and I’m not gonna pretend I have.

title: Five Days
text: five days and somewhere around day three I had a moment. not a dramatic one, nothing like that, just heavy and quiet and honest. I was sorry I made her cry. that sat with me way more than I expected it to. and I was sorry I couldn’t open up the way I probably should have, the way she probably needed me to at some point. u can look at something every single day, appreciate it completely, and still never once ask it how it’s been. I think I was doing that. I genuinely think I was doing exactly that and I didn’t clock it until the silence made it obvious. I was sorry. that part wasn’t for show.

title: What I Did With The Time
text: it was a random thought on a random Tuesday honestly, I just looked at my screen and felt like putting it down so I did. no countdown, no statement, deactivated in like four seconds because that’s how I make most decisions when they’re actually mine. worked, ate properly, trained, took care of myself the way I do when nobody’s watching. it was supposed to be maybe three days? I wasn’t counting. what I didn’t know was what was happening on the other side of that silence. the 2am texts, the spiral, all of it. I found out later and my first feeling wasn’t what u’d probably expect from me. it was just tired. genuinely just tired.

title: Some People Don’t Get Access
text: most people get the version of me that’s easy to be around. polished enough, appropriate enough, never makes it weird. that’s not me being fake, that’s just how I move when I don’t fully trust where I am. but occasionally, and I mean rarely, I make a decision about someone. a quiet internal thing that most people never even know is happening. and I open something up. not everything, I don’t think I’ve ever given anyone everything, but enough that it’s real. u were inside that decision. I was actively choosing u. I wonder sometimes if u knew what that actually meant. I genuinely wonder that.

title: That One Hour
text: there’s a specific hour of my day that started feeling different because of u and I’m not gonna tell u which one, that’s mine to keep. but I noticed it. and when everything went the way it went I noticed its absence the way u notice a sound that’s been in the background so long that the silence it leaves is somehow louder than the sound ever was? I’ve filled it now, I’m fine, that’s handled. but I sat with the vacancy for a little while first. longer than I wanted to probably. that’s urs. that’s the only one.

title: Don’t Confuse This
text: I want to be careful here because I really don’t want u reading this wrong. me still being here isn’t confusion or habit or me not knowing what happened, I know exactly what happened and I’ve sat with every part of it more than I’d like to admit. I’m here because I chose to be. and part of that choice, if I’m being honest in the language we actually speak to each other, is that somewhere underneath all of it I love u. not as an announcement. not loudly. just as this quiet thing that kept showing up every time I tried to logic my way out of this. I tried a few times actually. it kept showing up anyway.

title: You Have No Idea
text: u got a glimpse of something that most people don’t get access to, not the surface version, not just the guy who looks good and trains and keeps his peace, u had a window into something quieter and more specific than that. the version that actually thinks about people. that replays conversations at weird hours. that notices small things and doesn’t always say so. u saw maybe ten percent of that and I think it moved u, I think u knew it was rare even if u couldn’t name exactly why. ten percent. I don’t know why I’m telling u this rn. I guess I just wanted u to know the number.

title: Seven Days
text: I went offline because I felt like it, that’s genuinely the whole reason. no deeper thing happening, no statement being made, just a guy who saw people improving themselves on a screen and thought let me actually do that instead of watching it. deactivated on a whim. worked, slept clean, trained, read. I was completely fine honestly. and then I’m finding out later about the 2am texts and the spiral and accounts being deactivated and “if I didn’t love u I wouldn’t have done this” and I just… I read that and felt tired. because love doesn’t need that sentence. I don’t think it ever does. that’s not me being cold that’s just something I actually believe.

title: The Things You Normalize
text: the thing that sits with me most isn’t even what happened. it’s what u’ve made normal for yourself without realising it. the smoking, the vaping, the way u reach for something external every time something internal gets loud. the 2am guilt spirals that u turn outward instead of just sitting with. I’m not saying any of that as a judgment, I want to be clear about that, I’m saying it as someone who actually paid attention to u. who watched ur patterns because I was interested in the whole person. I saw more than u probably wanted me to and I didn’t say anything because I didn’t know how to yet. I still don’t fully know how to.

title: The Idea I Had Of You
text: I had a version of u in my head that was genuinely beautiful. not perfect, I wasn’t naive about it, but real and layered and worth the effort of actually knowing properly. someone who could hold weight without dropping it. someone who understood that real things are quiet and don’t need an audience. I was building toward that version of u, slowly, in my own way. and then something happened and I had to update it. not delete it, just update it. the original version is still in there somewhere. I just can’t lead with it the way I was before and I don’t know how long that lasts honestly. I genuinely don’t know.

title: I Can’t Figure You Out And I’ve Tried
text: I’ve run this back more than I want to admit. looked at the whole sequence, tried to find the thing I was missing, the variable that would make it make sense, and I keep landing in the same place every time. it’s not anger rn. it’s more like this specific confusion that I don’t experience often because I usually understand people. I loved u. I love u. in my own quiet way that doesn’t perform itself or need a witness. the kind that shows up in small decisions and middle of the night thoughts and voice notes I almost sent and didn’t. and I still can’t figure out how someone stands that close to something real and just… flinches. I’ve tried to understand it. I have. I just don’t.

title: The Door Is Still There
text: I’m still here. just sit with that for a second without making it into something. I’m someone who has zero problem with distance, with walking away from situations that cost more than they give back, I’ve done it before without losing sleep. so the fact that I’m in this space still, that I chose to come back to it, that I’m writing any of this at all… that’s not nothing. u know how to read me well enough to know what it actually is. so don’t make it loud. don’t make it a moment or a thing. just… walk through this carefully. that’s all I’m asking. just be careful with it this time.

title: In Our Own Way
text: I don’t need u to understand all of this. genuinely. I’m not writing it so u get it, I’m writing it because it’s 2am and I had a good day, actually a really good day, my body is tired in the right way, my head is clear, everything is exactly where it’s supposed to be. and somehow I’m still here writing about u. I don’t have a clean explanation for that rn. I’m not gonna look for one. in our own way, in that specific quiet language we have that doesn’t need an announcement or an audience, this is what it looks like when something actually meant something to me. that’s it. that’s everything I got.
